name: Naloxazone
summary: Naloxazone is an irreversible μ-opioid receptor antagonist which is selective for the μ1 receptor subtype. Naloxazone produces very long lasting antagonist effects as it forms a covalent bond to the active site of the μ-opioid receptor, thus making it impossible for the molecule to unbind and blocking the receptor permanently until the receptor is recycled by endocytosis.

pharmacology.text: Naloxazone is an irreversible μ-opioid receptor antagonist which is selective for the μ1 receptor subtype. Naloxazone produces very long lasting antagonist effects as it forms a covalent bond to the active site of the μ-opioid receptor, thus making it impossible for the molecule to unbind and blocking the receptor permanently until the receptor is recycled by endocytosis.

uses.en: It is used in research to study the μ1 subtype of the opioid receptor.
uses.zh: 它用於研究，以探討 μ1 亞型鴉片受體的功能。
uses.zhHans: 它用于研究，以探讨 μ1 亚型鸦片受体的功能。

fact.en: In acidic solution naloxazone partly turns into naloxonazine, two naloxone units joined together, and this may explain much of its long-lasting blocking effect.
fact.zh: 在酸性溶液中，naloxazone 會部分轉變成由兩個納洛酮單位相連的 naloxonazine，這可能是它阻斷作用特別持久的主要原因。
fact.zhHans: 在酸性溶液中，naloxazone 会部分转变成由两个纳洛酮单位相连的 naloxonazine，这可能是它阻断作用特别持久的主要原因。
